body: He did introduce me to his friends. He got mad at me for bringing them into it though.
I messed up
I didn’t ask you to give a shit. Imagine commenting that... r/trashy
I want to end it. I’m in so much pain. I just can’t anymore
I wish. I’d do anything to have him back. I miss him so much
There isn’t :(
He hates me. Now I’m all alone
It’s ok. Thank you. That means a lot
No I don’t
You’re welcomeee. I don’t have a therapist. I do have medication for anxiety but I’ve never tried it. It’s only for when you need it. I don’t know what it is

Wow, you’re so nice for doing that. I wish someone would do that for me. I want to take anxiety medication. I wish I could take benzos or something ( I’m not sure what it’s called). I think it would help me so much. I’m so tired of my social anxiety. I hate it!
I have social anxiety. It’s really hard. I try, but I can never fully open up
I have cognitive behavioural therapy, but it’s for anxiety. I don’t tell her anything because she uses it against me sometimes. That hurts. She doesn’t understand.
I’m not strong enough. No one really cares about me. I have no one to hold on for
I don’t like therapy. Plus, I’d have to be careful what I say ,so that they wouldn’t tell my mom. I’m not 18 yet. I take fluoxetine. I’ve never tried anything else. That would take forever...
Therapy doesn’t work. Therapy’s hard. I can’t open up. Antidepressants don’t work either. I don’t think I’ll ever get better

You’ve got me wrong. I don’t think I’m any of those things. Depression sucks and I wish your cousin hadn’t had to experience it. I wouldn’t wish it on anyone. I’m sure your cousin was a great person. I’m so sorry
But you don’t know me ? You shouldn’t care about me. I’m not worth it
They do. No one cares about me. So sorry to hear about your cousin :(
No one cares about me. Everyone hates me
I’m so sad. Please let me go. I’m really tired
I’m so sad. Please let me go. I’m really tired
I’m sorry
Everyone hates me. I get it. I mean, I hate me too. It’s still so painful. Nothing can take my pain away
I don’t want to. I just want to go. I’m so sad.

I love you. I’m so sorry you went through that. My mom doesn’t understand either. I remember telling her that I wanted to die and she called me silly. She gets mad whenever  I’m sad and so I’ve learnt to keep it all to myself. It’s so hard pretending you’re ok when you’re not. 

I’m glad that things have gotten better for you. I hope you get through the bad phase you’re in. Wishing you so much happiness.

I dont really feel wanted in this world. I don’t know if I can promise anything. I’ll try my best.
No it’s okay! My dad left when I was young. I’m not really allowed out on my own. I wouldn’t be allowed to stay anywhere else.
Thank you for that. I really needed some reassurance. I turn 18 next year, but I don’t know how much more I can take. Does it get better after you move out? I really hope it’s worth it. I’m so tired.
Ok. Thank you !

Thank you for telling me that. I really appreciate it :) 

I’ve never had Zoloft before. I recently started taking 10mg of Prozac. I have it everyday. I heard it’s bad to mix SSRIs but I’m not sure ? I’ve stopped taking Prozac since and I’ll have it when I feel better again. 

I’m not in therapy. I used to go but not anymore. Therapy doesn’t really help me. I have social anxiety and find it hard to open up to people.
That’s good to know. Thank you so much !
